card.name: Start of excretion words
card.fires_on: The first part "ex" of words like excretion, excreted and excreting, when describing how a substance leaves the body in urine. Weaker hits on "and" or "pH" in acid-base monitoring phrases.

modes.label: ex- of excretion
modes.description: The piece "ex" that begins excretion, excreted or excreting, right before "cretion" or "creted".
modes.example: Repeated injections may be required because of rapid<< ex>>cretion of calcium.

modes.label: Acid-base monitoring
modes.description: Linking word or "pH" in phrases about pH and blood gas monitoring.
modes.example: as indicated by arterial pH<< and>> blood gas monitoring
